The documentation gives generic official kit/shop links but no individual product links for these rows. Current supplier snapshots are recorded separately; revision-compatible individual ordering and checkout remain unqualified.

The Production Run 1 display assembly retains the legacy CAD root label FarmBot Genesis v1.8 Beta. This demo identifies the published design as Genesis v1.8 Production Run 1; confirm the installed hardware revision separately.
Official BOM quantity is 4 Jumper Links; full imported CAD contains 3 bodies named Jumper Link. The documented quantity has been preserved.

Conservative exact-name comparison resolves 99 standard rows by body name and count, leaves 62 identities unresolved, and identifies 1 count discrepancy. Body counts and purchased assembly counts are distinct.
O-ring frontmatter specifies 1.78mm thickness; component acceptance test specifies 1.5mm plus/minus 0.1mm. These values conflict; the source is preserved without manufacturing substitution.

Imported original CAD body name explicitly says O-Ring (7.5mm ID, modeled as 8mm). The source model contains this declared approximation. Frontmatter specifies 7.65mm ID/1.78mm thickness; component tests specify 7.5mm ID/1.5mm thickness. No manufacturing value has been silently selected.

Official shop tracks are 1500mm versus v1.8 BOM 1000mm; shop main beam is 1500mm versus standard BOM 750mm segments.
